changes.comment: sdk-ui-dashboard: Added @alpha context-decorator slots for the two automation management dialogs (AlertingManagementDialogContextDecoratorComponent and ScheduledEmailManagementDialogContextDecoratorComponent Dashboard props), mirroring the create/edit dialogs' seam: a decorator reads the management dialog context, adjusts members such as the automations list, and re-provides it via the newly exported AlertingManagementDialogContextProvider / ScheduledEmailManagementDialogContextProvider.
